resources.string: Face: always
Face: while talking
Drive the head, eyes and mouth with your own face. Straight away; tap again for only while Hold to talk is held, then off. The picture is never kept.
Check directions
Five short moves that settle which way is which on this phone
Check directions
Each move is read by itself; hold it until the next one shows.
Stop
Turn your head to your right
Look down at your chin
Tilt your head toward your right shoulder
Lean your whole head to your right
Close your right eye
No face seen, so nothing changed.
Directions set for this phone.
Directions set for %1$d of %2$d (the rest are as they were).
Puff
YOUR FACE
Face pins
Face pins: %1$d
A point of your face pulls a pin of the character: pick a point, then tap the character where it should pull
Pick a point of your face, then tap the character where it should pull. Drag a pin to move it.
Now tap the character where this point should pull.
Pick %1$s, then tap the character
Remove
Take this face pin off (and its pin, if it was made for it)
Strength
How far this pin follows your face: 1 = as far as your face moves
All pins
Every face pin at once: 1 = as set
Make one piece (%1$d on slices)
Move the face pins that bend a single slice onto the head's whole drawing, so it bends as one piece
Pick a point of your face first, then tap the character.
Tap on the character itself.
Arms and legs follow the hands and feet. Try the head, the mouth, the brows or the cheeks.
Add a face pin
Move a face pin
Remove a face pin
Face pin strength
All face pins
Make face pins one piece
Puff (hold to puff the cheeks). The face camera cannot see a puff, so this button does it; a take records it
Walk with your face
Walk with your face: lean to a side to walk that way, come closer to walk toward the camera. And Up close.
Left and right with your face
Your face to one side of where it rests walks it that way
On: put your face to the left or right of where it rests and the character walks that way, faster the further over. Back to the middle and it stops. Turning your head still turns its head.
Closer and further with your face
Come closer and it walks toward you; sit back and it steps away
On: lean in toward the camera and the character walks toward you, growing as it comes; sit back and it takes a few steps away. Where your face rests, it stands at its place.
Up close
It walks up to the camera; untick and it walks back
On: the character walks up to the camera and stays there. Off: it walks back to its place. No face needed.
These two follow your face: turn on Face above. Up close works without it.
